```{r}
length(intersect(symp_101_final_oligo_design$GuideSeq, syp_101_final_selected_gRNAs_with_control$GuideSeq))

syp_101_final_selected_gRNAs_with_control$unique_guide_name<- paste(syp_101_final_selected_gRNAs_with_control$Gene, syp_101_final_selected_gRNAs_with_control$Transcript_ID, syp_101_final_selected_gRNAs_with_control$MatchPos, sep = "_")
length(unique(syp_101_final_selected_gRNAs_with_control$unique_guide_name))

syp_101_final_selected_gRNAs_with_control <- syp_101_final_selected_gRNAs_with_control %>%
  group_by(GuideSeq) %>%
  mutate(gRNA_occurence = n()) %>% ungroup()

syp_101_final_selected_gRNAs_with_control <- syp_101_final_selected_gRNAs_with_control %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  mutate(transcript_per_gene = n_distinct(Transcript_ID)) %>% ungroup()

write_csv(syp_101_final_selected_gRNAs_with_control, file = "Final_reference_data/all_gRNA_data.csv")
map_file<- syp_101_final_selected_gRNAs_with_control %>% select(sgrna_ids=unique_guide_name,  	sgrna_seqs=GuideSeq)

map_file$id<- seq(0:(nrow(map_file)-1))
map_file$gene_pair_id<- "None"

map_file<- map_file %>% select(3,1,2,4)

write_tsv(map_file, file = "Final_reference_data/sym_101_map_file.tsv")

```
